title: ID0382350-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 170000976] Offline charger
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: SCB offline
Root cause:
Faulty router
Solution:
Replace router
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
NOTE TO QM:
Component:
Router
Wiring checkup
: 24V in input and WAN/LAN cable are also good.
Actions
: Every reboot, the router comes online. But in SCB logs we clearly see that the router goes offline since we lose ability to get logs but charging sessions are complete non-affected. Tried to factory reset the router and happened again. This is probably the 6th time it's been reported.
Field Report
: RC to send the field report
